setup.why: Check whether plan TP-1596 actually has linked runs, to explain why the probe response omits test_runs[].test_plan for TR-9058 (co-located in the __readonly__ folder, not necessarily plan-linked)
Cross-check filter_test_cases.is_dynamic's JSON type and test_plan-field presence for the SAME run TR-9061 via the plan-scoped listing, to compare against list_test_runs_v2's own serialization

attempts.changed: Rejected client-side before any HTTP call was made (bare integer id does not match the v2 route's PR-\d+ pattern, exactly as the contract warns). Switched to the PR-2005 identifier form.
Succeeded on first real HTTP attempt with PR-2005 + page_size=300 + include_closed=true.

TR-9058.name: probe run
TR-9058.test_plan: ABSENT (not plan-linked; confirmed via setup step 1)

undeclared_returned: urls (top-level: appears only in the flat 'returns' array, absent from the nested per-item schema's properties entirely, yet returned with a real 'self' sub-key on both runs)
links.test_cases (links is declared as a bare {type: object} with no enumerated properties, but returns these two real keys)

notes: 2 real rows came back for PR-2005 with page_size=300+include_closed=true (TR-9058, TR-9061) - not empty, so item shape is verifiable. filter_test_cases.is_dynamic is returned as BOOLEAN false by list_test_runs_v2 for both runs. Cross-checked run TR-9061 via get_test_plan_test_runs_v2(TP-1616): the SAME run's is_dynamic comes back as INTEGER 0 there. Combined with the sibling probe's finding that update_test_run_v2 also returns boolean false for TR-9061, that's now a 3-way split on one field's JSON type across three endpoints for the identical run: list_test_runs_v2=bool, update_test_run_v2=bool, get_test_plan_test_runs_v2=int. Projection comparison vs get_test_plan_test_runs_v2: that capability declares test_runs[].test_plan but it NEVER arrives (confirmed again here - TR-9061 via TP-1616 scope has no test_plan key at all), and returns an undeclared urls key too - same urls gap as here. But list_test_runs_v2 actually DOES emit test_plan (with id/identifier/name) for TR-9061, since this project-wide listing carries whatever plan link exists on the run itself, unlike the plan-scoped listing which apparently strips it. TR-9058 has no test_plan field in this response either, and that was verified (setup step 1) to be correct, not a gap: TP-1596 has zero linked runs, so TR-9058 is only folder-adjacent to that plan, not plan-linked - list_test_runs_v2 correctly reflects that by omitting the key rather than emitting a stale/null test_plan. issues and issue_tracker are declared in the flat 'returns' array but never appeared in either row, and overall_progress (declared in the nested schema) was also absent for both runs - consistent with the documented 'omitted when nothing executed' behavior (both are new_run with no executed cases), so treat that particular declared_missing entry as expected-but-still-technically-absent rather than a functional defect. Also worth noting: TR-9061's updated_at differed between my two calls (10:43:25Z in the probe vs 05:06:07Z moments later via TP-1616), and the TP-1616-scoped call showed overall_progress:{Untested:1} that wasn't present in the direct probe - the run's state changed between calls (likely a case was added by concurrent fixture activity), so that particular overall_progress difference is a timing artifact, not an endpoint-shape drift.
